headlines.title: Two Trump-backed candidates lose, Debbie Wasserman Schultz wins in Tuesday’s House primaries
headlines.description: Democratic Rep. Debbie Wasserman Schultz has won her party’s nomination for re-election, NBC News projects, while two Republican House candidates backed by President Donald Trump lost their primary bids in Florida on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Democratic socialist Angie Nixon upsets Alex Vindman in Florida’s Democratic Senate primary
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Nixon, a state lawmaker, will face GOP Sen. Ashley Moody, who was appointed to replace Secretary of State Marco Rubio, in the general election.

headlines.title: Rep. Donalds celebrates projected win in Florida GOP governor primary
headlines.description: Rep. Byron Donalds thanked supporters after his projected win in the Republican gubernatorial primary in Florida. Donalds was endorsed by President Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Angie Nixon projected winner in Florida Democratic Senate primary
headlines.description: NBC News projects Angie Nixon will win the Florida Democratic primary for Senate. It is a major upset over former National Security Council aide Alex Vindman.

headlines.title: Rep. Wasserman Schultz wins Florida’s 20th District Democratic primary, NBC News projects
headlines.description: Incumbent Rep. Debbie Wasserman Schultz wins the Democratic primary in Florida's 20th Congressional District, NBC News projects. NBC News’ Steve Kornacki analyzes the voting results in Florida's primaries.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. Cory Mills loses his Florida primary amid investigations
headlines.description: Mills lost to Republican Ryan Elijah, NBC News projects, while facing House Ethics Committee and Justice Department investigations. Mills has denied wrongdoing.

headlines.title: Republican Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly set to square off for Florida’s governorship
headlines.description: Donalds and Jolly easily won their primaries, NBC News projects, as Donalds enters the general election with a big financial advantage.

headlines.title: DeSantis ally and appointee is arrested on child sex abuse charges
headlines.description: Michael Caruso was removed as Palm Beach County’s clerk of courts and comptroller after his arrest was announced

headlines.title: Gov. Josh Shapiro takes a hard line against ‘predatory’ data center developers in Pennsylvania
headlines.description: Shapiro, a potential Democratic 2028 contender, earlier welcomed data center developments. His new executive order takes a starkly different tone toward the industry.

headlines.title: What two under-the-radar DNC moves say about the party’s direction: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki files a dispatch from the recent Democratic National Committee meeting in Austin. Plus, we preview the key primaries to keep an eye on before polls close tonight.

headlines.title: Andy Burnham says he’s not embarrassed about messaging someone impersonating a Trump aide
headlines.description: The prime minister exchanged messages with someone pretending to be the president’s chief of staff, Susie Wiles.
